title: Assistant Manager, CRM
description:
**About the Company**

BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid-markets with client service at its heart.

BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory & assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300+ Partners & Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi-fold.

**Role Overview**

BDO India is seeking a detail-oriented and process-driven Assistant Manager – CRM Data Management & Operations to oversee the integrity, quality, and governance of customer and business development data within Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).

The role will be responsible for driving CRM data quality initiatives, managing stakeholder data requests, ensuring compliance with Master Data Management (MDM) standards, supporting user onboarding and access management, and partnering with internal teams to continuously improve CRM processes and data governance practices.

This position requires strong analytical capabilities, hands-on CRM administration experience, stakeholder management skills, and a proactive approach to driving operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**CRM Data Governance & Quality Management**

* Ensure the completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity of CRM data across Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Quotes, and Orders.
* Conduct regular audits of CRM records against defined MDM standards and implement corrective actions to address data quality gaps.
* Lead data cleansing, de-duplication, validation, and enrichment initiatives to improve overall CRM data health.
* Maintain and monitor CRM data quality scorecards, identifying trends, risks, and areas requiring remediation.
* Track compliance with CRM data entry standards across business units and prepare periodic management reports.
* Identify recurring data quality issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen governance controls.
* Maintain documentation including data dictionaries, governance guidelines, audit logs, and process documentation.

**CRM Operations & Data Request Management**

* Manage the firm's CRM Data Request Management process, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of stakeholder requests.
* Review and approve account creation requests in line with established governance protocols.
* Facilitate backend creation and maintenance of Accounts, Contacts, and Leads within D365.
* Ensure adherence to defined service levels for all requests:
* Standard Requests – Within 3 business days
* Priority Requests – Within 1 business day
* Monitor request queues, maintain tracking logs, and provide regular updates to stakeholders.
* Analyze request patterns and identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities and enhance self-service capabilities.
* Develop and maintain reusable reports, dashboards, and data assets to support business development and leadership requirements.

**Stakeholder & User Management**

* Act as a key point of contact for CRM-related data queries and support requests from Partners, Directors, and business teams.
* Support onboarding and offboarding of CRM users, ensuring appropriate role-based access and security controls.
* Collaborate with the Digital Office and relevant teams on data migration activities, system enhancements, configuration updates, and process improvements.
* Conduct user awareness sessions and promote adherence to CRM data governance standards and best practices.

**Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare periodic dashboards and reports on data quality metrics, request turnaround times, compliance levels, and governance KPIs.
* Support the CRM Governance Lead in implementing data quality initiatives and governance frameworks.
* Identify process inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational effectiveness and user experience.
* Participate in CRM enhancement projects and contribute to the evolution of data governance capabilities within the firm.

**Qualifications, Experience & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field.
* 4–6 years of experience in CRM Operations, Data Management, Data Governance, or CRM Administration.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (preferred) or similar CRM platforms.
* Strong understanding of CRM data management, data quality, and Master Data Management (MDM) principles.
* Advanced Excel skills and working knowledge of Power BI.
* Experience in data cleansing, de-duplication, reporting, and maintaining data integrity across large datasets.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Detail-oriented, process-driven, and committed to data accuracy and governance.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within defined SLAs.
* Excellent communication skills and a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

title: Sr. D&T Analyst – Business Intelligence
description:
**Company Overview**

We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

This role advances modern Business Intelligence and AI for BI capabilities across General Mills business functions.
  
  
It partners with business, product, and technical teams to design, build, and scale trusted, governed, and user-friendly analytics solutions. The role focuses on enabling reporting, visualization, conversational analytics, and AI-driven insights with strong adoption, quality, and governance.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Business Intelligence and AI for BI capabilities
* Design, develop, test, automate, and launch BI, conversational analytics, and AI-driven summarization solutions using Tableau, Looker, BigQuery, and related tools.
* Build technical architectures, semantic models, prototypes, and governed data experiences for trusted natural-language querying, dashboard summarization, and scalable decision support.
* Lead design, code, model, and process reviews to ensure compliance with enterprise standards, AI governance, approved extensions, and performance best practices.
* Drive end-to-end delivery across discovery, requirements gathering, estimation, solution design, development, UAT, deployment, and post-go-live monitoring.

* Translate business needs into governed BI, NLQ, and AI summarization use cases with clear success measures and business value.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, BI leadership, and governance groups to shape requirements, prioritize initiatives, and recommend best practices.
* Lead workshops, pilot testing, feedback loops, issue triage, and continuous improvement efforts to strengthen usability, trust, adoption, and solution quality.
* Business Intelligence (Semantic Layer)

* Build and optimize complex SQL queries in BigQuery to support data models, semantic layers, and business analysis
* Translate business requirements into intuitive data models and LookML structures using star and snowflake schema principles

* Drive Git-based development, code reviews, change management, and CI/CD practices for reliable BI deployments
* Lead technical design discussions and code reviews to ensure architecture, data quality, and performance standards

* Experience: 8+ years of total experience with 6+ years of relevant experience designing and delivering BI and analytics solutions for business stakeholders.
* Expert-level skills in Tableau, SQL, Google Looker, Python, and BigQuery.
* Demonstrated experience building governed analytics products, semantic models, and scalable reporting solutions that support self-service analytics and decision-making.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate business requests into technical requirements and explain trade-offs across tools, data models, governance, and architecture options.
* Strong knowledge of dimensional modelling, metadata management, data governance, data warehousing, and enterprise data platforms.
* Proven ability to influence without authority and to partner effectively with business leaders, technical teams, and governance stakeholders to deliver high-value solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Thought-driven leadership to successfully deliver scalable team management and business solutions.
* Knowledge of at least one other programming language such as Python is a plus.

* Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and experience building processes supporting data transformation, dependency, and workload management.

* Experience with cloud services, specifically GCP, and DevOps practices using tools like Kubernetes and Terraform.
* Familiarity with big data tools (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Kafka) and various data ingestion tools (e.g., HVR, Airbyte).

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

Liaison and Change

title: Principal Data Consultant
description:

Data Platform / Trading Technology

We are seeking a
**Principal Data Engineer**
to design and build a next-generation proprietary data platform from the ground up at a global leading trading firm. You will create the systems, pipelines and automation needed to ingest, normalise, validate and deliver very large volumes of proprietary and alternative data across HFT, ETFs, options, indices, ecommerce, contracts and M&A.

This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role. You will work directly with traders, quantitative researchers, engineers and business stakeholders to turn fragmented, complex and often unstructured data into reliable, low-latency, research-ready and trading-ready datasets.

You will combine strong data engineering with automation, Python development and practical use of LLMs and AI agents to accelerate ingestion, extraction, enrichment, classification and data-quality workflows.

**What You’ll Do**

* Define and deliver the technical architecture for a firm-wide proprietary data platform, covering ingestion, storage, transformation, cataloguing, lineage, access and delivery.
* Build high-volume, high-reliability batch and near-real-time data pipelines for market, reference, alternative and proprietary datasets.
* Design pipelines and data models for HFT-related data, including market data, order data, execution data, ETF, options and index data.
* Build data ingestion and enrichment systems for ecommerce, corporate contracts, M&A, filings, news and other unstructured or semi-structured sources.
* Work closely with traders and quants to understand research, alpha, risk, execution and trading-workflow requirements, then translate them into scalable data products.
* Build automated ingestion, parsing, normalisation, deduplication, validation and reconciliation frameworks.
* Develop production-grade Python services, tooling and pipeline components for data extraction, transformation, orchestration and quality control.
* Apply LLMs, embeddings and AI-agent workflows to extract structured information from documents, contracts, filings, web content and other unstructured sources.
* Build automated data-quality, anomaly-detection and lineage frameworks to ensure datasets
* Mentor data engineers and collaborate with infrastructure, quant, trading and software engineering teams.
* Stay hands-on: write code, debug complex pipeline issues, review designs and drive technical decisions.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Significant experience as a Principal, Staff, Lead or Senior Data Engineer, ideally within a trading firm, hedge fund, market maker, fintech or data-intensive technology business.
* Expert-level Python, with a track record of building clean, performant, production-grade data engineering systems.
* Deep experience designing and operating large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple internal and external data sources.
* Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with experience across relational, columnar and/or NoSQL databases.
* Experience building data platforms or critical data infrastructure from scratch, rather than only maintaining existing systems.
* Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, schema evolution and automated validation.
* Experience processing structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, including APIs, files, web data, documents and event streams.
* Practical experience using LLMs or AI/ML techniques for extraction, classification, enrichment, search or workflow automation.

**Desirable Experience**

* Direct experience with financial datasets, including equities, ETFs, options, futures, indices, market data, reference data or alternative data.
* Exposure to HFT, electronic trading, execution, order-book or market-microstructure data.
* Experience with low-latency or high-throughput data systems.

title: SAP Consultant
description:
**Hiring: SAP Data Migration Consultant – S/4HANA Finance & Alteryx**

**Industry:**
IT Services & Consulting

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Budget:**
Up to ₹25 LPA

**Work Mode:**
Hybrid

**Locations:**
Multiple locations across India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced
**SAP Data Migration Consultant specializing in SAP S/4HANA Finance and Alteryx**
to support end-to-end financial data migration initiatives for enterprise SAP transformation projects.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in SAP data migration, financial data profiling and cleansing, source-to-target mapping, transformation, SAP S/4HANA migration tools, and financial reconciliation. Strong expertise in Alteryx Designer is essential for building scalable, reusable workflows that ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and auditability throughout the migration lifecycle.

The successful candidate will work closely with SAP Finance functional consultants, business stakeholders, data owners, technical teams, and project management teams to plan and execute migration activities from initial assessment through mock migrations, cutover, reconciliation, and post-migration validation.

**Key Responsibilities :**

**1. SAP S/4HANA Finance Data Migration**

* Lead and execute end-to-end data migration activities for SAP S/4HANA Finance implementations and transformation projects.
* Define migration scope, data objects, migration strategy, timelines, dependencies, and execution plans.
* Coordinate data extraction, profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, loading, and reconciliation activities.
* Participate in migration workshops with Finance, SAP functional, business, and technical teams.
* Execute mock migration cycles, identify defects, resolve data issues, and support cutover and go-live activities.
* Ensure migrated financial data meets business requirements, data quality standards, and audit expectations.

**2. Finance Data Objects and Mapping**

* Perform source-to-target field-level mapping for SAP S/4HANA Finance data objects.
* Work with financial master data and transactional data, including:
* General Ledger (GL) and Chart of Accounts (CoA)
* Profit Centers and Cost Centers
* Business Partners (BP) and Customer/Vendor Integration (CVI)
* Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP)
* Fixed Assets and Asset Accounting
* Tax-related master data
* Bank master data and related financial information
* Analyze source-system structures, target-system requirements, mapping rules, transformation logic, and dependencies.
* Collaborate with SAP Finance functional teams to resolve mapping gaps, data inconsistencies, and business-rule exceptions.
* Understand relevant SAP data structures and tables, including ACDOCA, BKPF, BSEG, SKA1, SKB1, LFA1, LFB1, KNA1, and ANLA.

**3. Alteryx Data Profiling, Cleansing and Transformation**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize Alteryx Designer workflows for large-scale data migration activities.
* Perform data profiling, parsing, cleansing, standardization, validation, deduplication, fuzzy matching, joins, pivots, and transformation.
* Build reusable and parameterized workflows, macros, and mapping tables to support repeatable migration cycles.
* Implement data quality rules, exception handling, reference-data management, and validation checks.
* Identify missing values, duplicate records, inconsistent formats, invalid master data, and other migration risks.
* Optimize workflow performance and implement appropriate logging, traceability, and data lineage practices.
* Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to improve data quality before loading data into SAP S/4HANA.

**4. SAP Migration Cockpit and Data Loading**

* Execute data loads using SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit, including staging-table or direct-transfer approaches where applicable.
* Understand migration object templates, source structures, mapping requirements, dependencies, and load sequencing.
* Prepare and validate migration files or staging data before loading.
* Monitor migration execution, analyze error logs, troubleshoot failed records, and coordinate defect resolution.
* Reprocess corrected records and validate successful loading into the target SAP environment.
* Support mock loads, dress rehearsals, production cutover, and post-go-live data validation.
* Work with SAP functional and technical teams to resolve loading errors and migration object issues.

**5. Financial Reconciliation and Data Validation**

* Perform pre-migration and post-migration reconciliation to confirm the accuracy and completeness of migrated financial data.
* Reconcile trial balances, General Ledger balances, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, fixed assets, and bank-related data.
* Validate record counts, financial balances, debit/credit totals, opening balances, and key control totals.
* Investigate reconciliation differences and coordinate corrective actions with Finance and SAP teams.
* Prepare reconciliation reports, migration sign-off documentation, issue logs, and audit-ready evidence.
* Ensure migration results meet agreed acceptance criteria and financial control requirements.

**6. Migration Planning, Cutover and Stakeholder Coordination**

* Develop migration plans, mock-cycle schedules, cutover checklists, issue trackers, and reconciliation templates.
* Coordinate migration dependencies across Finance, SAP functional, technical, data, and business teams.
* Track migration progress, data quality metrics, defects, risks, and outstanding dependencies.
* Support go/no-go assessments, cutover rehearsals, production migration, and stabilization activities.
* Maintain clear documentation of mapping rules, transformation logic, data quality findings, load results, and reconciliation outcomes.
* Communicate migration status, risks, and remediation plans to project stakeholders.

**Required Technical Skills :**

**SAP S/4HANA Finance**

* Hands-on experience in SAP data migration, preferably for SAP S/4HANA Finance.
* Strong understanding of Finance master data and transactional data migration.
* Knowledge of GL, CoA, Profit Centers, Cost Centers, Business Partners/CVI, AR/AP, Asset Accounting, Tax, and Bank Master data.
* Familiarity with SAP tables such as ACDOCA, BKPF/BSEG, SKA1/SKB1, LFA1/LFB1, KNA1, and ANLA.
* Practical experience with SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit, migration objects, load sequencing, error resolution, and reconciliation.

**Alteryx Designer**

* Strong hands-on proficiency in Alteryx Designer for data preparation and migration.
* Experience building reusable workflows and macros.
* Proficiency in data profiling, cleansing, joins, parsing, deduplication, fuzzy matching, regular expressions, and pivoting.
* Understanding of data quality rules, mapping tables, reference data, logging, lineage, and workflow optimization.

**Data and Reconciliation**

* Strong SQL skills for data extraction, validation, and analysis.
* Advanced Excel skills for mapping, reconciliation, data validation, and reporting.
* Ability to investigate data discrepancies, resolve migration defects, and maintain accurate documentation.

**Experience and Qualifications :**

* 5–8 years of relevant SAP data migration experience.
* Experience delivering 1–2 full-cycle SAP S/4HANA Finance migration projects.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in migration planning, data mapping, transformation, loading, reconciliation, and cutover.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Good to Have :**

* Experience with SAP BODS, SAP MDG, or SAP CPI.
* Exposure to Alteryx Server and enterprise workflow management.
* Basic knowledge of SAP Ariba supplier and purchase-order data.
* Experience with SAP ECC-to-S/4HANA migration or multi-system consolidation.
* Familiarity with data governance, financial controls, and audit documentation.

title: Infrastructure Engineer II – eApps
description:

**Key Accountabilities**

* Platform operations: Support the health, availability, administration, monitoring, and continuous improvement of assigned E-Apps platforms.

* Automation: Create and maintain Terraform configurations, Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell or PowerShell scripts for repeatable operational tasks and standard process execution.
* Observability and performance: Use Datadog or equivalent tools to review metrics, logs, dashboards, alerts, health checks, and performance indicators; identify trends and escalate abnormal conditions.
* Incident and ITSM support: Resolve routine and moderately complex incidents, participate in incident and change processes, maintain knowledge articles and runbooks, and escalate issues with clear evidence and impact details.
* Project delivery: Support infrastructure and application activities for assigned projects, deployments, testing, environment readiness, and operational handover.
* Continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve reliability, patch compliance, monitoring, recovery readiness, documentation, and standard operating procedures.
* Collaboration: Work effectively with D&T, network, OS, security, application, and vendor teams while sharing operational knowledge and following platform standards.
* Support Requirement: Participate in extended off-hours shift coverage, including overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time graduation in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Experience: Minimum 6 years of total IT experience, including at least 4 years supporting infrastructure or enterprise application platforms in production and business-critical environments.
* GCP and infrastructure: Hands-on experience with GCP services, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, load balancers, SSL/TLS certificates, DNS, networking, and access management.
* Automation and scripting: Practical experience with Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, or PowerShell for operational support, configuration, validation, and automation.
* Middleware and platform administration: Working experience with IIS, JBoss, and Apache across Windows and Linux platforms, including configuration, troubleshooting, patching, service management, and application integration.
* Operating systems and databases: Working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux administration, relational database concepts, and applications using Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
* Monitoring and operations: Experience with Datadog or equivalent observability tools, incident handling, patching, operational documentation, and root-cause investigation.
* ITSM and collaboration: Working knowledge of incident, problem, change, service request, escalation, and knowledge-management practices, with strong stakeholder communication skills.
* Core proficiency: Ability to manage assigned tasks effectively, troubleshoot methodically, work across teams, and build new technical skills continuously.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud breadth: Exposure to AWS or Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud platform.
* Delivery practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, DevOps practices, and release or deployment automation.
* Project methodology: Understanding of project delivery methods, including the Advantage project management methodology.
* Continuous improvement: Applies analytical thinking and AI capabilities where they provide business value to improve support, operations, and productivity.
* Professional behaviors: Demonstrates accountability, initiative, reliability, integrity, teamwork, learning agility, and a positive service mindset.

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Senior Consultant - Middleware/OCP
description:
**About The Job**
The Red Hat India Services team is looking for a Consultant to join us in Mumbai, India. In this role, you will help us ensure that our engagements are not just a technology implementation, but an organizational transformation. As a consultant, you will work with our lead architect in our engagements, cocreating innovative software solutions using emerging open source technology and modern software design methods in an agile environment. You’ll be coached by the team to facilitate the design and technical delivery of our solutions. As you do so, you’ll create enthusiasm for building great software using principles of open source and agile culture. You'll support everything from the scoping to delivering the engagements. Successful applicants must reside in a city where Red Hat has mentioned the location.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Applies software engineering principles to the operations domain.
* Ensures service reliability meets users’ needs, including internally critical and externally visible services
* Uses software & systems engineering to design, build, and run large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant systems
* Develop API’s using Red Hat technology products and service
* Design, develop, and manage Kafka-based data pipelines
* Provide issue analysis on Kafka applications
* Monitor Kafka performance and troubleshoot issues to minimize downtime and ensure uninterrupted data flow, enhancing decision-making and operational efficiency.
* Participates in an on-call rotation within a geographically distributed team to provide 24x7x365 production support, with responsibility to respond to urgent customer issues
* Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems
* Help us cover domains including microservices, API management, and web-scale architectures, DevOps engineering and application delivery, container-based continuous delivery (CD), i.e., using Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform,
* Team up with Red Hat and the open source community to engineer innovation-based software solutions, designed to further accelerate our customers’ success at their transformation journey
* Work as a trusted adviser to our customers and use your critical thinking skills to tackle tough problems in an innovative way
* Train and coach team members both on technical and non-technical skills
* Remain an active coder as this is required during our engagements and maintain deep direct technical knowledge of container management systems (CMSs), application infrastructure, architectures, and development solutions
* Support presales and post-sales field teams during workshops, proofs of concepts, pilots, and production deployments

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of experience and advanced knowledge of middleware technologies, including enterprise web or middleware development project experience with application integration
* Knowledge and some experience in OpenShift by Red Hat;
* Experience with another Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution will also be considered
* Hands on experience using Cloud as a development environment
* JEE and Middleware technology
* Good technical skills and experience designing and implementing JEE solutions.
* Thorough experience with at least one of the major middleware solutions, preferably Red Hat JBoss Middleware; experience in Oracle WebLogic, IBM WebSphere, WebMethods, Tibco, etc. will also be considered.
* Hands on experience in application development with Agile approach
* Hands on experience on building pipelines and CI/CD.
* Knowledge on Devops and Microservices
* Enterprise Java development skills are an advantage.
* Knowledge of Hibernate and Tomcat is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience on AMQ, API management like 3scale.
* Ability and desire to learn new technologies on your own and apply new concepts to problems

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with or knowledge of Red Hat’s technologies like Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform, Red Hat Fuse, Red Hat 3Scale, Red Hat AMQ, or Red Hat AMQ Streams (Kafka)
* Working with some community technologies like Argo CD, Tekton Pipelines, Helm, or Jenkins
* Working with application and infrastructure monitoring
* Experience with or knowledge of JavaScript, Golang, Python, or Shell Scripting
* Experience with or knowledge of technologies AngularJS, React.js, and Vue.js

**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
  
  
**Inclusion at Red Hat**
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: API Support Engineer
description:
Experience: 0–2 years in API support, application support, integration support, or a similar technical role.

Job Location: Mumbai or Pune

Job Type: Full-time

Job Summary: We are looking for an API Support Engineer responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting APIs and system integrations with clients, suppliers, and third-party service providers.

The candidate will work closely with the Development, QA, Product, Database, and Infrastructure teams to identify API issues, analyze technical problems, coordinate resolutions, and ensure stable operation of production systems.

Experience in Travel / OTA / Hotel Booking / APIs will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

1. API Monitoring & Support

Monitor API performance, availability, response time, error rates, and transaction failures. Monitor production APIs and identify abnormal behavior or service interruptions. Investigate API failures, timeouts, slow responses, incorrect responses, and connectivity issues. Ensure critical API issues are identified and escalated promptly. Perform regular health checks of APIs and integrations.

2. API Troubleshooting

Analyze API requests and responses to identify the root cause of issues.

Troubleshoot REST APIs, JSON, XML, HTTP/HTTPS, authentication, headers, parameters, and response codes. Check request/response logs and application logs. Identify whether an issue is related to the client, supplier, application, database, network, or infrastructure. Coordinate with development teams for code-level issues. Coordinate with suppliers/third parties for external API issues.

5. Logs & Database Analysis

Analyze application and API logs to identify errors and transaction failures. Perform basic SQL queries to investigate transaction and booking-related issues. Verify data consistency between API responses, application databases, and supplier systems.

Work with senior developers/DBAs for complex database-related issues.

6. Client & Supplier Coordination

Communicate with clients and suppliers regarding API connectivity and transaction issues. Collect complete technical information before escalating an issue. Share request/response details, timestamps, booking references, error messages, and relevant logs with the concerned team. Follow up with external suppliers until the issue is resolved. Provide clear technical updates to internal teams and clients.

7. Incident Management

Prioritize incidents based on business impact and severity. Immediately escalate major issues affecting bookings, revenue, API availability, or multiple clients. Maintain incident timelines and resolution details. Perform basic root-cause analysis and prepare incident reports for major issues. Identify recurring problems and recommend permanent solutions.

Required Technical Skills.

Good understanding of REST APIs and API integration. Strong knowledge of JSON and XML. Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS and HTTP status codes. Experience with Postman / Swagger. Basic to good knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Ability to analyze application and API logs.

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Good communication skills. Ability to work under pressure during production incidents. Good coordination with Development, QA, Product, Infrastructure, clients, and suppliers. Travel Domain Knowledge – Preferred

Qualification

Bachelor's degree / Diploma in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Experience.

0–2 years of experience in API Support, Application Support, Production Support, Integration Support, or a similar technical role.

Candidates with experience in Travel Technology / OTA / Hotel Booking Systems / API Integration will be given preference.

* Define governed business metrics, KPIs, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, calculations, data definitions and reusable analytical entities.
* Develop analytics engineering assets using SQL, dbt-style transformation patterns, Fabric semantic models, Power BI datasets, lakehouse/warehouse tables and curated analytical data products.

* Move beyond visualisation by translating patterns, trends and exceptions into actionable business insights, recommendations and decision support.
* Data Modelling, Data Analysis & Insight Generation
* Apply strong data modelling skills including dimensional modelling, star schema design, semantic modelling, analytical data product modelling, metric modelling and data mart design.
* Perform deep data analysis using SQL, analytical thinking, data profiling, reconciliation, segmentation, trend analysis, variance analysis and root-cause investigation.
* Partner with business SMEs, data engineers, data architects and product owners to convert business questions into robust data models, analytical logic and reusable reporting assets.
* Ensure insights are grounded in trusted data, explainable logic, meaningful context and clear business interpretation.

* Enable AI-assisted analytics using capabilities such as Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI where relevant.
* Design AI-ready semantic layers that provide business context, trusted metrics, governed definitions and explainability for conversational BI and agentic analytics use cases.
* Identify appropriate use cases for AI in BI while recognising where traditional dashboards, governed reports or human-led analysis remain more suitable.
* Governance, Adoption & Analytics Operating Model
* Define governance standards for dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, certified datasets, access controls, refresh schedules, lifecycle management and reporting asset ownership.
* Support integration with governance and catalogue platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Immuta or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Create templates, design standards, dashboard review checklists, documentation patterns and adoption playbooks for consistent analytics delivery.
* Enable business users through self-service analytics training, guardrails, metric definitions and trusted data consumption practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* BI and dashboarding - Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, executive dashboards, self-service reporting, embedded analytics.
* Semantic and analytics engineering - Semantic layers, Fabric Semantic Models, Power BI datasets, metrics layer, governed KPIs, SQL, dbt-style modelling, analytical data products, business glossary alignment.
* Data modelling - Dimensional modelling, star schema design, snowflake schema design, semantic modelling, metric modelling, data mart design, canonical/domain model awareness, data dictionary creation.
* Data analysis and insight generation - Advanced SQL, data profiling, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, variance analysis, segmentation, data storytelling, business analysis, actionable insight generation.
* AI and next-generation analytics - Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure OpenAI, conversational BI, semantic search, AI-assisted insights, agentic analytics.

title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer – eApps
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**

* Lead the engineering, operation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure supporting third-party Enterprise Applications (E-Apps), with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as the primary cloud environment.
* Own hands-on infrastructure engineering across cloud and hybrid environments, including secure design, provisioning, migration, deployment, capacity, reliability, and lifecycle management.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform as the primary tool, supported by Ansible, Python, and Shell scripting; use PowerShell where required for Windows administration.
* Partner with solution teams, Enterprise Applications stakeholders, security, network, and service teams to define hosting standards, technical specifications, operational readiness, and support models.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and promote standardization, observability, ITSM discipline, and secure-by-design practices across the E-Apps platform.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Operate and continuously improve the E-Apps infrastructure estate, including availability, performance, capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.
* Design and provision GCP infrastructure using approved architecture and security patterns across compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, certificates, logging, monitoring, storage, and secrets management.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and deployment patterns and develop Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell scripts to eliminate manual work and improve deployment consistency.
* Administer and troubleshoot web and application platforms including IIS, JBoss, and Apache, with understanding of Java application hosting, reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS offload, certificates, ports, and application integrations.
* Implement observability and operational insight using Datadog and GCP monitoring/logging capabilities, including dashboards, metrics, logs, traces, alerting, health checks, service-level indicators, and actionable runbooks.
* Apply ITSM practices across incident, problem, change, service request, knowledge, and major-incident management; maintain accurate operational documentation and participate in governance and change reviews.
* Act as a senior escalation point for outages, complex incidents, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, security findings, and recovery activities; drive permanent corrective actions.
* Establish standards and governance for configuration, access, automation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness of new and existing applications.
* Mentor team members and coordinate support coverage while promoting knowledge sharing, effective handoffs, and continuous improvement across the platform team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Experience: 8–12 years of experience designing, implementing, operating, and supporting complex infrastructure and enterprise application environments, including high-availability and mission-critical systems.
* GCP — primary requirement: Strong hands-on experience with GCP services and architecture, including Compute Engine, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, SSL certificates, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Secret Manager, storage, and hybrid connectivity.
* Terraform — primary engineering keyword: Demonstrated experience creating maintainable Infrastructure as Code, reusable modules, environment configuration, state management, policy controls, and automated provisioning at scale.
* Scripting and automation: Strong Shell scripting and Python experience for operational tooling, integrations, validations, remediation, and workflow automation; practical experience with Ansible for configuration management and application/platform automation.
* Web and application infrastructure: Hands-on understanding of IIS, JBoss, and Apache administration, configuration, troubleshooting, patching, reverse proxying, Java application hosting, SSL/TLS, certificates, load balancers, and integration with enterprise applications.
* Observability: Good hands-on experience with Datadog and/or equivalent observability platforms, covering monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, alerting, synthetic or endpoint checks, and incident correlation.
* ITSM and operations: Working knowledge of ITSM practices and operational controls, including incident, problem, change, service request, major-incident, SLA, knowledge-management, and root-cause-analysis processes.
* Systems and troubleshooting: Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server, networking fundamentals, firewalls, DNS, identity/access, relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL, and vendor-supported enterprise applications.
* Leadership: Ability to lead technical initiatives, manage competing priorities, communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders, and mentor junior engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud breadth: Working knowledge of AWS and Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud requirement for the role.
* Delivery practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, release automation, DevOps practices, and secure software delivery.
* Platform experience: Experience supporting SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, vendor-built applications, cloud migrations, and hybrid enterprise environments.
* Certifications: GCP, Terraform, Ansible, ITIL, or other relevant cloud and infrastructure certifications are desirable.
* Continuous improvement: Ability to use AI capabilities where they deliver business value and improve support, operations, and user productivity.
* Leadership behaviors: Demonstrates ownership, initiative, integrity, constructive challenge, collaboration, and an engaging leadership style; develops people and drives initiatives from idea through execution.

**SUPPORT REQUIREMENT**

* The role requires extended off-hours coverage, including overnight, weekend, and holiday on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs and the team’s operational support model.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Oracle Database Administrator (Navi Mumbai) | RQ-0018
description:
**Location :**
Navi Mumbai (Seawoods)

**Position Type:**
Full-time, Permanent
  
  
**Shift Timings :**
UK time zone (11am to 8pm IST/12pm to 9pm IST)
  
  
**About Us**
Founded in 1995, Zema Global Data Corporation empowers organizations to simplify complexity, reduce risk, and make faster, more confident decisions that drive measurable results. Over the past two years, Zema Global has accelerated its growth through strategic investment and acquisition to strengthen our global leadership. Together we’re helping our customers gain a Decisioning Advantage - one bold idea at a time. With a presence across global energy, commodity, and financial markets, Zema Global empowers customers to simplify complexity, reduce risk, and make faster, more confident decisions that drive measurable results.
  
  
At Zema Global, we Think Big, Make It Happen, and Win as One. We thrive on collaboration, creativity, and respect, united by a shared drive to innovate and deliver meaningful impact for our customers and communities. If you’re inspired by solving complex challenges and contributing to a culture that values purpose and performance, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are hiring an Oracle Database Administrator to own the availability, performance and security of our Oracle databases running on Exadata in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will run Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB-D) and/or Exadata Cloud@Customer, support mission-critical production workloads, and automate routine operations so the team can scale. This is a hands-on senior role: you will be the go-to expert for Exadata on OCI, shape our database standards and architecture, and act as the main technical contact with Oracle Support and Oracle's cloud operations team.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
Exadata and OCI administration
  
  

* Provision, configure and manage Exadata VM clusters, Oracle Homes and Container Databases (CDBs/PDBs) on ExaDB-D or Exadata Cloud@Customer through the OCI Console, CLI, APIs and dbaascli.
* Manage Exadata-specific features: Smart Scan, Storage Indexes, Hybrid Columnar Compression (HCC), Exadata Smart Flash Cache, IORM and resource plans.
* Scale OCPU/ECPU and storage, and plan capacity across VM clusters to balance cost and performance.
* Work with Cloud and Network teams on VCNs, subnets, NSGs, security lists, IAM policies and compartments that support the database estate.

Patching and lifecycle
  
  

* Plan and apply quarterly Release Updates (RUs) for Grid Infrastructure and Database, plus Exadata infrastructure maintenance windows, with minimal downtime using rolling patching and out-of-place Oracle Home moves.
* Lead database upgrades and migrations (for example 19c to 23ai) and on-premises-to-OCI migrations using Zero Downtime Migration (ZDM), Data Pump, RMAN, GoldenGate or Data Guard.

High availability, backup and disaster recovery
  
  

* Administer Oracle RAC, ASM and Grid Infrastructure on Exadata.
* Configure and maintain Data Guard / Active Data Guard (including cross-region standbys) and perform switchover and failover drills.
* Manage backups with RMAN, OCI Object Storage and/or Autonomous Recovery Service; regularly test restores against defined RPO and RTO targets.
* Maintain and test the disaster recovery runbook, including OCI Full Stack DR where used.

Performance and monitoring
  
  

* Tune SQL and instance performance using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, execution plans and Exadata cell metrics.
* Monitor databases with OCI Database Management, Operations Insights, Enterprise Manager and alarms; act on alerts before they affect users.

Security and compliance
  
  

* Implement TDE with OCI Vault keys, Unified Auditing, Data Safe, Database Vault and least privilege access.
* Support audits and controls (for example SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS) with evidence and remediation.

Automation and operations
  
  

* Automate provisioning, patching and routine tasks with Terraform (OCI Resource Manager), Ansible, Bash, Python or PL/SQL.
* Resolve incidents and problems, own root-cause analysis, and work Oracle Support SRs to closure.
* Keep runbooks, architecture diagrams and standards current; mentor junior DBAs and advise developers on schema and query design.
* Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation and after-hours change windows.

**Essential**
**What You'll Bring**

* 6+ years as an Oracle DBA supporting production databases, including 2+ years administering Oracle databases on OCI, ideally ExaDB-D or Base Database Service.
* Strong hands-on skills with Oracle 19c (23ai a plus), multitenant (CDB/PDB), RAC, ASM and Grid Infrastructure.
* Proven experience with Data Guard, RMAN backup and recovery, and patching/upgrade cycles.
* Solid performance tuning with AWR, ASH, execution plans and Exadata offload diagnostics.
* Working knowledge of OCI core services: IAM, compartments, VCN networking, Object Storage, Vault and Monitoring.
* Linux administration skills (Oracle Linux) and scripting in Bash and/or Python.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Desirable
  
  

* Oracle certifications such as Oracle Database Administration Certified Professional, OCI Architect Associate/Professional, or an Exadata Database Machine / Exadata Cloud implementation certification.
* Experience migrating large databases to OCI with ZDM, GoldenGate or cross-platform transportable tablespaces.
* Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform and OCI Resource Manager; CI/CD for database changes (Liquibase, Flyway).
* Familiarity with Autonomous Database, Autonomous Recovery Service, Data Safe and OCI Full Stack DR.
* Exposure to multicloud setups such as Oracle Database@Azure, @AWS or @Google Cloud.
* Experience in regulated industries (finance, energy, healthcare) and with cost optimization of OCI.

**Soft Skills**

* Calm, methodical troubleshooting under pressure during production incidents.
* Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, application owners and leadership.
* Ownership mindset: you document, automate and follow changes through to verification.
* Collaborative approach with Cloud, Network, Security and Development teams.

* Strong overall understanding of project requirements, deliverables and workflows.
* Understanding of training and development concepts.
* Ability to implement, test and troubleshoot systems.
* Ability to effectively deliver presentations to both internal and external stakeholders.

**Other Requirements**

* Experience of working in cross cultural environment is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle and SQL database.
* Able to think analytically in a problem-solving environment.
* Ability to plan, prioritize and work under pressure to meet deadlines.

**People Skills**

* Able to actively initiate inter-discipline / department dialogue.
* Strong written and oral presentation skills.
* Able to transfer and capture location knowledge and mentor/coach others within the Location to engage in knowledge sharing and system activities.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
  
  
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: L2 Linux & Database Support Engineer
description:
**Job Opening: L2 Linux & Database Support Engineer**
**Job Title:**
L2 Linux & Database Support Engineer
  
  
**Location:**
Airoli, Navi Mumbai (On-site)
  
  
**Experience Required:**
5–8 Years
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Work Schedule:**
09:00 AM – 06:00 PM | Monday to Saturday (6 days/week)
  
  
**Positions Available:**
1 Resource
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced and dependable
**L2 Linux & Database Support Engineer**
to manage, maintain, and optimize our enterprise Linux operating systems and database environments. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Linux administration, hands-on database operations (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MS SQL), patching, backup management, and preventive maintenance. You will serve as an escalation point for infrastructure and application incidents, ensuring maximum uptime, security compliance, and strict SLA adherence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Linux OS Administration & Troubleshooting**

* Provide L2-level administration, configuration, and troubleshooting for enterprise Linux operating systems (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, SuSE).
* Perform continuous system monitoring, performance tuning, kernel parameter updates, disk management (LVM), and log analysis.
* Implement server hardening, user management, SSH security, and security best practices across Linux servers.
* Database Operational Administration & Maintenance
* Execute day-to-day database administration, monitoring, maintenance, and health checks (Oracle / PostgreSQL / MySQL / MS SQL).
* Conduct regular database health reporting, index maintenance, tablespace management, and query performance checks.
* Oversee database patching, version updates, and vulnerability remediation in coordination with application teams.
* Backup, Storage & Infrastructure Support
* Coordinate, execute, and troubleshoot database backups (RMAN, pg\_dump, mysqldump, or enterprise backup tools) and perform periodic restoration test runs.
* Provide cross-functional support across server hardware, NAS/SAN storage, basic network configurations, and security devices.
* Conduct preventive maintenance, proactive health checks, and capacity planning for Linux and database platforms.
* Incident Management & OEM / Vendor Escalation
* Resolve complex L2 incidents, service requests, and problem tickets within defined SLA targets.
* Lead end-to-end technical escalations and vendor coordination with OEMs (e.g., Red Hat, Oracle, hardware vendors) and application developers to resolve critical technical issues or software bugs.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major system or database outages and document permanent fixes.
* Application Support & Compliance
* Assist application support teams with database connectivity, environment readiness, deployment support, and troubleshooting.
* Implement OS patching, security updates, and vulnerability remediation to maintain security compliance.
* Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational logs.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience: 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in Linux administration and database support in enterprise environments.
* Linux Expertise: Advanced knowledge of RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu, shell scripting (Bash/Python), systemd, LVM, user/permission management, and networking configurations.
* Database Management: Working knowledge of database administration (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server) including backup/restore, user management, and performance monitoring.
* Security & Patching: Demonstrated experience in automated/manual OS & database patching, vulnerability scanning tool remediation, and system hardening.
* Backup & Recovery: Practical knowledge of enterprise backup tools (e.g., Veeam, Commvault, RMAN) and DR procedures.
* Vendor & SLA Management: Experience coordinating with hardware/software vendors, managing high-severity escalations, and operating within an ITIL incident management framework.

**Preferred Certifications (Plus)**

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) / Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
* Database Certifications (e.g., Oracle Certified Associate/Professional, PostgreSQL Certified Engineer).
* ITIL Foundation certification.

title: L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer - Location - Mumbai
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer**

*Enterprise Backup • Commvault • DR/NDR • Data Protection*

**Position**

L2  Backup Administrator Engineer

**Experience**

5–10 Years

**Employment Type**

[Full-Time / Contract]

**Location**

Mumbai

**Primary Technology**

Commvault Backup & Recovery

**Preferred**

Veritas / Cloud Backup/Commvault

1. Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced L2/L3 Backup Administrator Engineer responsible for designing, implementing, administering, troubleshooting, and optimizing enterprise backup and recovery infrastructure. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Commvault, with additional knowledge of Veritas for migration activities.

The engineer will manage backup and recovery across virtual machines, physical servers, databases, Kubernetes, storage infrastructure, and enterprise applications, while supporting DR/NDR operations, backup migrations, restoration, capacity planning, security, compliance, and continuous improvement.

2. Key Responsibilities

Backup Solution Design & Implementation

**•**
Design, implement, configure, and manage enterprise backup solutions for critical systems, applications, and databases.

**•**
Understand application and infrastructure requirements and design appropriate backup policies and protection strategies.

**•**
Build new backup environments/solutions from scratch based on business and technical requirements.

**•**
Perform workload onboarding and migration to new backup platforms with minimum business disruption.

**•**
Configure backup policies, schedules, retention, storage pools, deduplication, compression, and auxiliary copy requirements.

**•**
Ensure backup solutions meet defined RPO, RTO, retention, and business continuity requirements.

Commvault Administration

**•**
Administer and troubleshoot Commvault Backup & Recovery environments, including CommCell, MediaAgents, storage pools, deduplication databases, libraries, policies, and schedules.

**•**
Manage backup, restore, auxiliary copy, retention, and storage operations.

**•**
Monitor backup health, failed/pending jobs, storage utilization, deduplication, and overall environment performance.

**•**
Troubleshoot Commvault configuration, infrastructure, connectivity, and performance issues.

**•**
Raise and manage OEM/vendor support cases and coordinate resolution through closure.

**•**
Implement applicable Commvault security and hardening capabilities.

Backup Monitoring & Operations

**•**
Monitor backup operations and ensure successful completion within agreed SLAs.

**•**
Review daily backup reports and identify failed, missed, pending, or abnormal jobs.

**•**
Perform root-cause analysis for recurring backup failures and implement permanent corrective actions.

**•**
Maintain daily/weekly/monthly backup operational reports and dashboards.

Backup Troubleshooting & Restoration

**•**
Handling incidents and complex backup-related technical issues.

**•**
Troubleshoot backup and restore failures across VMware/VMs, physical servers, Linux, Windows, Solaris, Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Kubernetes, and enterprise applications.

**•**
Perform file-level, VM-level, database-level, and application-level restoration.

**•**
Validate restoration integrity and prepare RCA/corrective action plans for major incidents.

Disaster Recovery – DR/NDR

**•**
Develop and maintain backup and disaster recovery procedures.

**•**
Configure and maintain backup/replication copies at DR and NDR locations.

**•**
Enable backup protection for workloads migrated to DR and maintain required secondary copies.

**•**
Participate in DR drills, BCP exercises, and disaster recovery activities.

**•**
Validate restoration capability during DR drills and document observations and corrective actions.

Backup Migration

**•**
Plan and execute migration from legacy backup platforms to Commvault or other target platforms.

**•**
Support Veritas-to-Commvault workload migration.

**•**
Analyze existing policies, retention, storage consumption, and application dependencies before migration.

**•**
Validate successful backup and restoration after migration.

Capacity Planning & Optimization

**•**
Perform backup data sizing and capacity planning.

**•**
Monitor storage growth, deduplication ratios, compression, and retention consumption.

**•**
Optimize backup policies, storage utilization, backup windows, compression, deduplication, and auxiliary copy strategies.

Security & Compliance

**•**
Implement backup security and access controls as per organizational policies.

**•**
Support advanced Commvault security features and secure backup practices.

**•**
Support internal/external audits, including RBI and banking regulatory requirements where applicable.

**•**
Maintain audit evidence, backup reports, restoration records, policies, and governance documentation.

Documentation

**•**
Maintain up-to-date backup infrastructure and operational documentation.

**•**
Prepare Backup Architecture, Configuration, Policy Matrix, Backup/Restore SOPs, DR/NDR Configuration, Migration Plans, Health Check Reports, RCA documents, DR Drill documents, and Capacity Reports.

**•**
Update documentation after major configuration or infrastructure changes.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

**•**
Work with Application, Database, Server, Storage, Network, Security, and DR teams.

**•**
Understand application requirements and recommend suitable backup/recovery solutions.

**•**
Coordinate with OEMs and vendors for complex issues and technical escalations.

**•**
Participate in change management, implementation planning, and technical reviews.

Extended & Major Incident Support

**•**
Handle complex and critical backup incidents independently.

**•**
Provide L3 support for major backup failures, data recovery issues, and infrastructure incidents.

**•**
Provide support during DR drills, migrations, planned maintenance, and major implementation activities during weekends/night shifts when required.

**•**
Leave/comp-off will be managed as per agreed organizational/customer terms and applicable policy.

Continuous Improvement

**•**
Prepare and implement a quarterly backup process improvement plan.

**•**
Identify opportunities to improve reliability, performance, security, and operational efficiency.

**•**
Automate repetitive monitoring and operational activities where feasible.

**•**
Reduce recurring incidents through permanent corrective actions.

3. Mandatory Technical SkillsBackup Technologies

**•**
Strong hands-on experience with Commvault Backup & Recovery.

**•**
Enterprise backup administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, restore, retention, deduplication, compression, auxiliary copy, and capacity management.

Protected Workloads

**•**
VMware / Virtual Machines; Physical Servers; Linux; Windows; Solaris; Oracle; Microsoft SQL Server; PostgreSQL; MySQL; Kubernetes; Enterprise applications.

Storage & Infrastructure

**•**
Hands-on understanding of SAN, NAS, disk-based backup storage, backup repositories, storage capacity/performance, and deduplication storage.

**•**
Understanding of backup servers, MediaAgents, Fibre Channel, Ethernet networking, server hardware, and RAID concepts.

DR/NDR & Migration

**•**
Disaster Recovery concepts, secondary/replicated backup copies, DR/NDR architecture, DR drills, RPO/RTO, and restoration validation.

**•**
Experience migrating workloads from Veritas or other legacy platforms to Commvault.

4. Preferred Skills & CertificationsCertifications

**•**
Commvault certification.

**•**
Veritas Backup certification/experience.

**•**
Relevant cloud backup certification.

Additional Knowledge

**•**
Aws , GCP , Hitachi Vantara and Commvault backup technologies.

**•**
VMware and Kubernetes backup/recovery.

**•**

Database migration from on premise to cloud (AWS). Expected to have an experience on Postgres migration. Specifically older version of Postgres to a newer version of Postgres.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
A Senior Database Engineer to own indexing strategy, query performance, and database architecture decisions across our PostgreSQL estate. You'll work on systems where scale is a given — large tables, high write volume, and workloads where a wrong indexing decision costs real money in latency and infrastructure spend. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role: you'll be trusted to make the trade-offs, not just execute someone else's spec.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Design and tune indexing strategies (B-Tree, GIN, GiST, Hash, BRIN, and partial/expression indexes) for large-scale production workloads
  
  
Diagnose and resolve query performance issues using EXPLAIN ANALYZE, planner statistics, and PostgreSQL internals knowledge
  
  
Evaluate trade-offs between read performance, write amplification, storage cost, and maintenance overhead when proposing schema or index changes
  
  
Partner with backend engineering teams to review schema designs, query patterns, and migrations before they hit production
  
  
Own database architecture decisions for new and evolving services — index strategy, partitioning, and data modelling at scale
  
  
Set and enforce best practices for index maintenance, auto vacuum tuning, and bloat management
  
  
Mentor other engineers on query optimization and PostgreSQL fundamentals
  
  
**Required**
**What We're Looking For**
Deep, hands-on experience with PostgreSQL internals — MVCC, the query planner, and how indexes are actually used (not just created)
  
  
Proven ability to design and reason about B-Tree, GIN, and GiST indexing strategies for real production workloads
  
  
Experience diagnosing and resolving performance issues on large (100M+ row) tables
  
  
Comfort with the trade-offs between different index types and knowing when not to add an index
  
  
Strong communication skills — you can explain a technical trade-off to both an engineer and a stakeholder
  
  
**Preferred**
Experience with BRIN indexes on time-series or append-only data
  
  
Experience with jsonb/full-text search indexing at scale
  
  
Familiarity with exclusion constraints, range types, and PostGIS/spatial workloads
  
  
Experience tuning auto vacuum, WAL, and replication for high-write systems
  
  
Seniority & Experience
  
  
Senior-level role. We expect fundamentals to be a given — the real bar is applied judgment: can you reason through a genuinely ambiguous, large-scale trade-off and defend the decision, not just recite definitions.

description:
TITLE
  
  
Application Support Analyst II
  
  
**Who We Are**
Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you’ll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Application Support Analyst acts as an individual contributor within support, driving service excellence within the support organization through hands-on ticket work, demonstrating quality, ownership, and resolution pace. They handle day-to-day items submitted through the support portal, internal technical tasks and investigation, as well as client-facing communication as regards support items. This role contributes to ongoing improvement by owning documentation and identifying opportunities to streamline operations. Overall, the Application Support Analyst provides the backbone of the Loss Control support team’s technical ticket resolution capabilities.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as an individual contributor by maintaining active ticket ownership and demonstrating strong closure habits and quality expectations
* Provide first-line technical support for Duck Creek applications, responding to user inquiries and resolving incidents.
* Investigate and troubleshoot application issues, working to identify root causes and implement resolutions.
* Support day-to-day ticket operations, reduce backlog, and improve service delivery
* Escalate complex issues specialized departments when necessary.
* Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions for future reference in support knowledge bases.
* Work with internal teams to identify recurring issues and recommend long-term solutions to improve system performance.
* Collaborate with application development and infrastructure teams to resolve issues and implement new features.
* Maintain response time, communication standards, and a professional approach to customer resolution
* Participate in training sessions and stay up to date on system updates, application changes, and new functionalities. Perform all other duties and activities as required.
* Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values:
* Mission: To empower insurers to reimagine the future of insurance
* Vision: To transform insurance technology, helping insurers be smarter, faster, and more efficient, and ultimately provide the best protection for people and businesses
* Values: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  
Bullet list describing the education & experience to perform the role, including any certifications.
  
  
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 2-5 years of experience in application support, IT operations, or a similar technical support role.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Duck Creek Technologies products or similar enterprise software.
* Knowledge of IT service management frameworks such as ITIL.
* Experience in the insurance technology sector or related industries.

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with an ability to resolve basic application issues.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively document incidents and collaborate with team members.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Understanding of IT environments, including basic networking, infrastructure, and cloud technologies.
* Ability to escalate complex issues and collaborate with senior staff to resolve them.
* Familiarity with enterprise software release cycles and deployment processes.
* Knowledge of incident, problem, and change management processes.
* Customer-oriented mindset, focused on providing prompt and effective technical support.
* Strong organizational skills, with attention to detail in managing incident logs and troubleshooting steps.
* Ability to adapt to changing technologies and stay updated on new features and system enhancements.
* Basic knowledge of Agile and DevOps methodologies as they relate to application support.
* Ability to work independently and in a team, supporting larger initiatives and projects as needed.
* Analytical skills to evaluate performance trends and suggest improvements in application support processes.
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and development in application support best practices.

**Technical Competencies**

* SQL Server: Ability to perform basic queries (CRUD), understand database schemas and relationships between tables, and create or update stored procedures, functions, views, SQL Server Agent jobs, maintenance plans, and other SQL Server resources. Intermediate or above understanding of advanced SQL topics, including T-SQL, cursors, CTEs, temporary tables, joins, subqueries, transactions and error handling, indexing, query execution plans and performance analysis, XML querying, basic dynamic SQL, backups and restoration, and SQL tracing/profiling. Strong working knowledge of SQL Server Replication, including configuration and creation of replication, monitoring replication health, and troubleshooting/debugging replication failures, synchronization issues, and related data problems.
* Azure: Working knowledge of the Azure Portal and core services used to support applications, including Azure App Services, Azure Storage, Azure SQL, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory/AAD) including identity and access management, and Azure Key Vault. Ability to review configuration and logs, debug and troubleshoot application issues, connect to and query Azure SQL databases, perform basic tracing, monitor and troubleshoot Data Factory pipelines, and investigate authentication, access, and secret/configuration-related issues.
* Debugging and Troubleshooting: Ability to systematically investigate and isolate application, data, integration, and configuration issues using logs, error messages, stack traces, database queries, trace files, and other diagnostic information. Able to reproduce issues, identify root causes, distinguish application defects from configuration or data problems, and clearly document findings for escalation when required.
* IIS: Working knowledge of Internet Information Services (IIS), including websites, application pools, authentication, application configuration, log files, and a basic understanding of bindings. Ability to restart applications/application pools, review IIS and application logs, troubleshoot availability and connectivity issues, and diagnose common application pool, authentication, and configuration-related problems.
* SSO / SAML: Working knowledge of Single Sign-On (SSO) and SAML-based authentication, including identity provider and service provider concepts, SAML assertions, metadata, certificates, claims/attributes, and authentication flows. Ability to troubleshoot common SSO issues involving configuration, user access, claims, redirects, and failed authentication.
* API: Working knowledge of REST APIs and web services, including HTTP methods, endpoints, request/response formats, headers, authentication, status codes, and JSON/XML payloads. Ability to test and troubleshoot API calls using tools such as Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI, review API documentation and request/response data, and diagnose common authentication, connectivity, configuration, and data-related issues.
* Other Technical Skills: Working knowledge of FTP/SFTP, XML/XSLT, and PowerShell. Ability to read, modify, and troubleshoot XML and XSLT; use PowerShell for basic scripting, automation, and troubleshooting; configure, test, and troubleshoot FTP/SFTP-based file transfers; and read and understand application code for troubleshooting purposes, including .NET, JET, HTML, JavaScript, and other relevant languages or technologies.

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
